about: S-challenges - MAI DOBÁS (/challenges), KIHÍVÁSOK (/challenges/pool), the challenge sheet and Ma's NAPI DOBÁS (design round B frames lifeos/challenges-1, challenges-2, ma-4; ma-1 / ma-2 for the picked teaser). Account M = user@tracker.local. Written by make-states.mjs (edit that file, not this one). The running dev backend has no migration 033: the challenge reads are contract bodies typed by lib/lifeos-api.ts (B-rewards-challenges' Phase-4 block), checked by fixture-schema-check.mjs; Ma's GET /lifeos/today is S-ma's edit list + the Phase-4 key challenge. Nothing is written live.
